descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S17 Tapping Generate again while the first attempt is still retrying, both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state (UAT OAT-03 step 4; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94422 AC 5)
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up … (UAT OAT-03 step 3; UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1; UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed); TFA-94745 state 4; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94422 AC 5; TFA-92568 AC 5)
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android (UAT 3.3; UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Local stack with Haiku forced to fail (so the first call spends time in retries before Mistral answers); Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each with a typed dictation

When Double-tap Generate Note & Finish, then tap it once more while it still shows it is generating

Then One note is produced and saved; no duplicate note text and no second billing request for the same note; the dictation is unchanged

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): cp mustContain the note heading. Backend, read right after each chart (diagnostics:list keeps 8 rows per user): exactly one notes.generateNote ok row per chart in the run window; Hospital: exactly one notes.suggestBilling row for the note; one stored note per chart; encounterNotes unchanged

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-03.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: dev/newspec-c.
